body.purpose: Composer, transcript, and button labels at text-xs.

label.purpose: Uppercase nav group labels and compact meta.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Row hovers, segmented controls, tool block expand (150ms).

motion.name: duration-micro
motion.purpose: State feedback on interactive rows and buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sparse primary action on workbench chrome.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary, #080808); color: var(--primary-foreground, #f5f5f5); font-family: 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, #080808) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #8f8f8f) 30%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition: none; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #050505); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted, #dfdfdf); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #8f8f8f) 30%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-ghost { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--foreground, #050505); } .ds-input { height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--input, #f2f2f2); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--background, #ffffff); color: var(--foreground, #050505); font-size: 0.75rem; outline: none; transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #3c3c3c); } .ds-input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #8f8f8f) 50%, transparent); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-input { transition: none; } }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Row
components.description: Session list row in app sidebar.
components.css: .ds-nav-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--sidebar-foreground, #050505); font-family: 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 1.35; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); outline: none; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent, #dfdfdf); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, #050505); } .ds-nav-row-active { background: var(--sidebar-accent, #dfdfdf); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--sidebar-ring, #8f8f8f) 50%, transparent); } .ds-nav-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #080808); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-label { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav-meta { flex-shrink: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--muted-foreground, #3c3c3c); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-row { transition: none; } }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Inspector mode or compact enum picker.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--border, #dfdfdf) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-segment { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 24px; padding: 0 10px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground, #3c3c3c); font-family: 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); outline: none; } .ds-segment:hover { color: var(--foreground, #050505); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent, #dfdfdf) 40%, transparent); } .ds-segment-active { background: var(--background, #ffffff); color: var(--foreground, #050505); font-weight: 500; } .ds-segment:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #8f8f8f) 30%, transparent); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-segment { transition: none; } }

components.name: Settings Meta Badge
components.description: Compact status chip in settings rows.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; max-width: 100%; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--muted, #dfdfdf); color: var(--muted-foreground, #3c3c3c); font-family: 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.35; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Transcript Tool Row
components.description: Collapsible tool block header in transcript.
components.css: .ds-tool-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: 100%; height: 24px; padding: 0 4px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground, #3c3c3c); font-family: 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); outline: none; } .ds-tool-row:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent, #dfdfdf) 40%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #050505); } .ds-tool-row:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, #8f8f8f) 50%, transparent); } .ds-tool-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; flex-shrink: 0; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted-foreground, #3c3c3c) 45%, transparent); } .ds-tool-dot-running { background: var(--primary, #080808); animation: ds-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-tool-label { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tool-chevron { flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 0.625rem; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.45; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tool-row { transition: none; } .ds-tool-dot-running { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview: H3Code desktop is a long-session workbench for solo developers running agents on local repos. The interface optimizes for orientation speed: connection health, run lifecycle, transcript, tools, and git context stay legible without decorative chrome. Visual hierarchy comes from engineered neutrals, tight type at text-xs / text-[11px], and structural hairlines—not card stacks or marketing gradients.
keyCharacteristics: Engineered achromatic neutrals with near-zero chroma
Dense operator layout: h-7 sidebar rows, text-xs controls
Hairline borders + micro-shadows on overlays only
Tactile hover/active on interactive rows and ghost buttons
Inter Variable + Geist Mono; fixed rem scale

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: --primary is the only brand chroma on product chrome. Chart tokens and destructive are semantic exceptions, not decoration.

rules.name: The Canvas-Not-Card Rule
rules.body: Transcript, lists, and settings rows live on background. Do not wrap routine content in bg-card panels.

rules.name: The Muted-Ink Floor Rule
rules.body: text-muted-foreground on background or muted must meet 4.5:1. If a meta label feels faint, darken muted ink toward foreground.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Product UI uses fixed rem sizes. No clamp() hero type on workbench surfaces.

rules.name: The Eleven-Pixel Meta Rule
rules.body: Secondary information defaults to text-[11px]. Do not shrink below text-[10px] except mono IDs in sidebars.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Prefer border-border over shadow to separate regions. Toolbars use bottom hairline, not a second background block.

rules.name: The No Ghost-Card Rule
rules.body: Never pair border: 1px solid with wide soft shadows (blur ≥16px) on the same element.

dos: Do edit colors only in apps/desktop/src/app.css (and apps/web/src/app.css when touching marketing).
Do use semantic Tailwind tokens in all components.
Do keep sidebar and transcript rows at h-7 with text-[11px]–text-xs for density.
Do show connection, run, and error state in plain language with visible focus rings.
Do use skeletons for content loading and reserve spinners for inline actions.
donts: Don't use SaaS marketing patterns on product surfaces: hero metrics, gradient CTAs, identical feature card grids, section eyebrows on every block.
Don't ship generic AI-tool slop: purple gradients, sparkle motifs, hype copy, or decorative gradients on the workbench.
Don't use neon, glassmorphism, or heavy atmospheric backgrounds on desktop chrome.
Don't use consumer chat bubbles, avatars, or playful empty states where a dense dev tool is appropriate.
Don't wrap routine transcript or list content in elevated cards; nested cards are forbidden.
Don't use side-stripe borders, gradient text, or border-radius above 16px on panels.
Don't hardcode font families or literal colors in .svelte files.
